name: hasa-agent-arena
description: Compare HASA models on the same task in isolated git worktrees, and apply the winner only after you have reviewed it.

hasaArena.orchestratorPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the HASA Agent Arena checkout used to launch the orchestrator. Leave empty to use the extension's own installation directory.

hasaArena.orchestratorUrl.markdownDescription: Connect to an already-running orchestrator instead of launching one, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:7801`. The token is still taken from secret storage.

hasaArena.defaultCandidateCount.description: How many candidate models a new comparison starts with.

hasaArena.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for orchestrator HTTP requests made by the extension.
